concerns.text: FR-010 ('System MUST perform final validation of all generated artifacts against their respective schema contracts and record the results in validation logs') is not anchored to any User Story. It only references SC-006, leaving the requirement without a concrete user‑story driver.

SC-006 ('All artifacts ... MUST pass schema validation via validate_schemas.py; validation logs must be present and show zero errors') is not linked to any User Story. It stands alone without a story that defines why this success criterion is needed.
